$comment: The public-surface gate's axes for @cosyte/transform, read by `cosyte-internal-refs` (pnpm check:no-internal-refs), the shared gate in @cosyte/script-utils. This file adds detection and never subtracts. The two extra rules carry this repository's former phase and slice rules as they were, so the shared gate reads at least what the former scripts/check-no-internal-refs.sh read: `roadmap §4.5` citations, `the slice` and `each slice`, and the phase phrasings the shared rules now let through.
$prefixes: Keyed on our own programme prefixes, never on a WORD-N shape: segment-field references (MSH-9, PID-3, PV1-44, OBX-5, RXA-20) are what this package's documentation is made of. HL7-\d{3,4} stays a designation because a v2 table written HL7-0203 is reference material here.
$surface: What a consumer reads: README.md, LICENSE, TRADEMARKS.md, and docs-content/ (docs.cosyte.com). CHANGELOG.md is where identifiers belong, and dist/ is built from src/, whose doc comments and string literals are scanned below.
